newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast crude prices track WTI fall.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast crude prices track WTI fall.

text.p: Prices for U.S. West Coast light crude ended $1 lower, tracking a collapse in West Texas Intermediate (WTI), while regional differentials stayed flat on a lack of buying interest.
December WTI cash finished $1 lower than Tuesday's late spot market. The collapse in the roll came as traders sold WTI grade in favour of lighter ones.
West Coast traders looked to increase purchases of Line 63 crudes after ARCO said they would allow more crude through the prorated line during November.
